target_customer: Pharmacies, hospitals, clinics and HMOs in Nigeria
problem: Pharmacies buy from open air medicine markets at higher prices with counterfeit risk and little credit.
business_model: B2B marketplace margin on drug wholesale plus inventory financing and services

founders.name: Samuel Okwuada
education: Master's degree in pharmacy (institution not named)
previous_startups: Three companies started, two exited while at university (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Pharmacist and self taught engineer who began coding at 14 per YC page.

founders.name: Victor Benjamin
founders.background_notes: YC page: over 10 years of pharma sales, led sales and expansion. Employer not named.

investors: Consortium of local and international financial institutions

competitors.name: eMedicStore
competitors.what: Online platform for pharmacy stores with bulk ordering for wholesale and retail pharmacies

competitors.name: Lifestores Healthcare (OGApharmacy)
competitors.what: Pharmacy chain that moved into a B2B pharmacy marketplace
competitors.traction_then: Claimed more than 10 percent of Nigerian pharmacies as registered customers (as of Oct 2022)

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace and credit software is standard; the harder parts are supply chain, credit risk and logistics across Nigeria.

defensibility.rationale: Credit relationships, supplier terms and delivery coverage across 34 of 36 states create operational barriers, though rivals such as DrugStoc and Lifestores serve the same buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Remedial grew independently and claims over 10,000 customers on its site.

market_need_then: Pharmacies bought from open air markets with counterfeit risk; the founder said COVID era medicine demand as an importer inspired the business (Techpoint, 2023).

branding.domain_note: Uses remedial.health, a health TLD, not remedialhealth.com.
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch, TechCabal, Techpoint and Financial Times recognition as fastest growing African health tech firm in 2025 per the company site.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong trade press and a 2025 Financial Times recognition claimed on its site, but no evidence the name itself drove growth.

pivots.from: Private label contract manufactured drugs sold to pharmacies
pivots.why: Techpoint says it began as a private label business; later moved to digitizing pharmacy supply.

outcome_analysis: Remedial Health raised a pre-seed and 4.4 million dollar seed in 2022 and a 12 million dollar Series A in August 2023, 8 million equity and 4 million debt, led by QED with Ventures Platform. It claims over 10,000 customers and the Financial Times fastest growing recognition in 2025. No later round was found, so Series B status is unknown.
notes: Pre-seed 1M rests on a headline seen in search results (People of Color in Tech, Feb 2022) and was not opened. Seed and Series A confirmed by two outlets each. Aggregators disagree: CB Insights says 18.5M over 7 rounds, FundedIQ says 13.4M over 3 rounds; unresolved. Founding year conflicts (2020, 2021, 2022); 2020 per Techpoint. Lifestores source is Oct 2022, nine months after the batch; noted. Investors for seed not retrieved.
